caseName: Kissinger v. Reporters Committee for Freedom of Press
caseNameFull: Kissinger v. Reporters Committee for Freedom of the Press

opinions.text: Application for stay of order of the United States District Court for the District of Columbia, entered January 25, 1978, presented to The Chief Justice and by him referred to the Court, granted pending final disposition of the appeals in the United States Court of Appeals for the District of Columbia Circuit.
